4-01.title: Lucky
4-01.fullText: Lucky the Goat Adam and Yasmin went on holiday. They stayed with Grandmother. Grandmother had a party. Everyone wanted to come. Grandmother had a kid goat. The kid was called Lucky. Yasmin looked after Lucky. She gave her a bottle. She gave her a cuddle. She played with her every day. The holiday was over. Yasmin was sad. Adam had spots. They couldn't go on the aeroplane. Chicken pox, said the doctor. Come back in two weeks. Lucky, said Yasmin.

4-16.title: The Wedding
4-16.fullText: Oxford Reading Tree Stories Stage 4 More Stories Paque The Wedding This story is called The Wedding written by Roderick Hunt and illustrated by Alex Brickda When you hear this sound, turn the page. Now open the book. Let's read the story together. Jo was mom's sister. She was getting married. Wilma was happy. She wanted to be a bridesmaid. Wilf was unhappy. He didn't want to be a page boy. The grandparents came. They came for the wedding. What a journey! They said. Mom made Wilma's dress. Grandmother helped. Wilf looked at the material. Oh no, he thought. Grandmother made the cake. Wilma put a bride and groom on it. It's wonderful, said Jo. Wilma's dress was finished. Biff and Chip came to see it. I like weddings, said Chip. I don't, said Wilf. Jo took Wilf's measurements. She gave them to Mom. Wilf was unhappy. He didn't want to be a page boy. Mom had been shopping. She had a surprise for Wilf. What is it? asked Wilf. It's a suit, said Mom. You're not a page boy, said Jo. It was a joke, said Grandmother. It was the day of the wedding. Dad made a video. Biff took a photograph. Wilf liked his suit. He was glad he wasn't a page boy. He was happy. Everyone was happy. There was a big party. Everyone danced. I like weddings, said Wilf. Will you get married? asked Wilf. I don't know, said Wilma. Published in copyright Oxford University Press.
